title: Human Purpose
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Human purpose means that people were created to know God, glorify Him, worship Him, walk with Him, and live according to His will. Human life finds meaning in God, not in self-invention.
summary: Human purpose means that people were created to know God, glorify Him, worship Him, walk with Him, and live according to His will. Human life finds meaning in God, not in self-invention.
christFocus: Jesus Christ restores human purpose by reconciling sinners to God and teaching them to live for the Father’s glory. In Him, believers are brought back to the life they were created to pursue.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Human beings were created for God’s glory. Life is not ultimately about self-expression, achievement, pleasure, control, or the approval of others. People exist because God made them and calls them to live before Him.

Scripture describes this purpose in worship, obedience, love, justice, humility, stewardship, and fellowship with God. Human beings were made to know God and reflect His character in the world He made.

Sin corrupts human purpose by turning people inward. Instead of worshiping God, sinners chase idols, self-rule, comfort, power, and human praise. This leaves people restless even when they gain what they thought would satisfy.

Christ restores purpose by bringing sinners back to God. In Him, ordinary life becomes worship, service becomes meaningful, suffering is not wasted, and obedience becomes the path of restored humanity.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
People can become deeply discouraged when life feels pointless or when they cannot perform what the world celebrates. Scripture gives a purpose deeper than productivity, health, success, or public recognition.

This doctrine tells the overlooked and weary that life still matters before God. A person’s purpose is not lost because of disability, age, poverty, weakness, or hidden service. In Christ, life is lived for God’s glory.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Measure your life by God’s purpose rather than worldly success. Seek to know Him, love Him, worship Him, obey Him, and glorify Him in ordinary faithfulness. Bring your work, weakness, relationships, suffering, and service under the purpose of Christ.
